laws.1_law_zero: Absolute determinism, active readiness probes, zero assumptions.
laws.2_conway_law: Code architecture mirrors business logic without toxic coupling.
laws.3_postels_law: Be conservative in transmission, resilient in ingestion.
laws.4_cap_theorem: Guaranteed consistency and state integrity in the SSoT.
laws.5_simplicity: Enforce DRY, KISS, and YAGNI strictly.
laws.6_pareto_rule: Focus engineering rigor on the 20% core stabilizing the system.
laws.7_hyrums_law: All observable behaviors of an API become implicit dependencies.
laws.8_teslers_law: Complexity is conserved; push it to the backend to keep interfaces clean.
laws.9_brooks_law: Modular automation triumphs over resource massification.
laws.10_galls_law: Complex systems that work invariably evolve from simple working systems.
laws.11_amdahls_law: Optimize real bottlenecks rather than secondary processes.
laws.12_goodharts_law: Metrics reflect true operational health, not superficial targets.
laws.13_wirths_law: Combat software bloat with clean, efficient execution.
laws.14_boy_scout_rule: Leave the codebase cleaner than you found it; zero technical debt.
